signals.summary: US national parks framed for early autumn — 'parks that are even better in autumn', National Parks Week features and fall-colour trail coverage. Landscape-led and clearly seasonal.
signals.why_now: Fresh within 24 hours: Forbes '12 National Parks Even Better In Autumn' 1.7h, National Parks Week Acadia doodle 1h and Cape Hatteras 2.4h. (Fire, closure and fatality park news gated out.)

signals.summary: Coverage of hiking in remote, wifi-free mountain country — Kyrgyzstan's mountains framed as an off-grid TikTok trend. Big-sky mountain scenery, highly producible as landscape.
signals.why_now: Two independent outlets carried the Kyrgyzstan wild-hiking story within the same window (AOL 94.6h, The Independent 94.6h). Modest source count with Reddit's EarthPorn feed down this run.

signals.summary: Seasonal wild-food foraging as the year turns — foraging courses and 'nature's pantry' framing. Producible as still lifes of mushrooms, berries and gathered produce.
signals.why_now: Seasonal/evergreen: an Illinois Extension seasonal foraging course feature plus scattered seasonal-nature items. Thin sourcing this run with Reddit down, but squarely on-season.
